title: waffle maker, round 4 quarters
text: waffle maker, round 4 quarters. This waffle maker is pretty good - but only at the highest possible heat.  It didn't really work at all on the lower heats so I think it's funny there is a dial for temp.  It cleaned up well - carefully.  You can't submerge it but you can carefully rinse it. The cord easily wraps around the back of the maker nicely.  Liked that.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. Further, I never accept free products - my reviews are 100% honest and reflect my own personal experience.

product_metadata.title: VCJ 8 inches Waffle Maker , 1000W Mini Round Waffle Iron with Anti-overflow Design, Non-stick coated Plates, Indicator Light, Adjustable Temperature Control
features: Adjustable Temperature Control: It is easier to get the tender or the crispy result with the temperature control. Anti-skid feet offer the strong grab and keep the waffle maker stable on the countertop.

Easy for Clean-up: Equipped with the non-stick coated plates, making and the cleaning become ultra easy. The waffle will be removed from the plate easily and you just use a damp cloth to wipe the plate slightly after the waffle maker cools down.

Convenient to Store: Constructed with compact body, it can easily to be stored in all sizes of the kitchen. Perfect for dorms, apartments and the RV traveling. Feel free to contact us if you need any assistance.

Indicator Lights: The indicator lights informs you of the different condition of the waffle maker. Red light let you know the machine is turning on while the green light tell you the machine is heating. Double plates press can achieve evenly cooking.

No More Mess: The wrap-around channel can catch the excess better to make the most of the ingredient. No fuss in the kitchen. It prevents the butter from overflowing or leaking. Thanks to the 1000W output of the waffle maker, the waffle can be finished quickly and efficiently.
